ui.title: Check-in Quiz
ui.h1: Want to spin for bonus stars?
ui.p: Ideas for checking in each morning and after school, plus a few things for the home screen. Rate each one 1 to 10. 10 = love it! Tap 🤔 Other to say how you'd do it.
ui.other: Instead of "%s", how would you do it? Say it or type it.

about: Hundreds of reviews of wall calendars like Skylight say the same thing: after a few weeks the family stops using it and it becomes "a very expensive wall hanging." The ones that last give kids a reason to tap it every day.
Parents online put chores on sticks and draw them at random so nobody argues about who got the worse job. Some put workouts on the sticks too ("30 sit-ups").
Families who keep using their screens say a family photo slideshow is the part they look at most.
A common question in reviews: "Can the kids change the chores?" Many parents want a code on the grown-up settings.
Rate each card 1 to 10 (10 = love it, 1 = no way), or tap 🤔 Other and say what you'd do instead. Got an idea? Tap 🎤.

ideas.title: Morning check-in
ideas.desc: When you come downstairs, tap your face. You see your stars this week, your streak, and what's due today and the next few days.

ideas.title: Spin for double stars
ideas.desc: After you check in, spin the wheel. It picks 2 of today's chores or workouts that are worth double stars today. Only before 8 AM on school days.

ideas.title: Rare wheel prizes
ideas.desc: Most spins give double stars, but some slices are a mystery box, "pick your own double", or a super-rare golden slice.

ideas.title: Check-in streak
ideas.desc: A flame grows every day in a row that you check in. Miss a day and it starts over (trip mode pauses it).

ideas.title: After-school scratch-off
ideas.desc: First tap after school gives you a scratch-off. It boosts one homework or practice item if you finish it before dinner.

ideas.title: Bonus workouts on the wheel
ideas.desc: Some slices are a quick bonus workout, like 30 sit-ups or 50 makes, for extra stars.

ideas.title: Random picks for shared chores
ideas.desc: For chores you share (dishes, trash), the screen picks who does which at random, so nobody argues.

ideas.title: Family photo slideshow
ideas.desc: Our photos slowly rotate at the top of the home screen.

ideas.title: Screen wakes when you walk up
ideas.desc: The screen dims when nobody's in the kitchen and wakes up when someone walks by.

ideas.title: Weather + what to wear
ideas.desc: Today's weather on the home screen, with a tip like "Coat and hat day" or "Shorts OK".

ideas.title: Sports scores
ideas.desc: Vikings, Wolves and Gophers scores, plus results from Nellie's and Nash's own games.

ideas.title: "Hey Google, I'm up"
ideas.desc: Say it to the speaker in your bedroom and it checks you in (you still spin downstairs).

ideas.title: Hub talks through the Google speakers
ideas.desc: Reminders on the bedroom and kitchen speakers, like "Leave for practice in 10 minutes".

ideas.title: Code on the Mom & Dad tab
ideas.desc: A short code so only parents can change chores, star values and prizes.

ideas.title: Porch camera on the screen
ideas.desc: When the doorbell rings, the screen shows who's at the door.
